NETSUITE_MCP_URL.title: NetSuite MCP server URL
NETSUITE_MCP_URL.description: Account-specific AI Connector Service URL. Every tool in the account: https://<accountid>.suitetalk.api.netsuite.com/services/mcp/v1/all. Only the MCP Standard Tools SuiteApp: https://<accountid>.suitetalk.api.netsuite.com/services/mcp/v1/suiteapp/com.netsuite.mcpstandardtools. Find the account ID under Setup → Company → Company Information, lowercased with underscores replaced by hyphens, so 1234567_SB1 becomes 1234567-sb1.
